item.title: Upcoming Events
item.description:
SKEGNESS COACH TRIP SEPTEMBER`25

Sunday 7th September 2025

Back by popular demand, for the second time this year, we are arranging another visit to Skegness on Sunday 7th September 2025!

Departs: Leicester General Hospital @08:00 (Free Parking)

Returns: Leaving Skegness Seafront @17:00

Tickets are available on a first-come, first-served basis at the bargain price of just £15 per person. Renal patients will get refunded on the day.
